<!--
spatial_report_dataset_child.Rmd - one dataset's full section set.
Rendered via knitr::knit_child() from spatial_report_template.Rmd's loop,
which binds `ds` (this dataset's snapshot, see build_spatial_report_dataset()
in R/utils_spatial_report.R) and `ds_name` (its name) into the calling
environment before invoking knit_child(envir = environment()) -- both are
therefore in scope here, along with everything from the PARENT's setup
chunk (params, %||%, render_plot(), render_plot_spatial(), tr(), tr_fmt()).

i18n Phase 5 : toutes les chaines visibles passent par tr() / tr_fmt()
(resolues cote serveur au moment du clic via params$i18n_strings, fallback
= cle FR).

IMPORTANT (caught by rendering this template for real, see integration
notes) -- two fixes baked in:
  1. knit_child() runs this file ONCE PER DATASET within the SAME overall
     render session -- knitr enforces a single, document-WIDE chunk-label
     namespace, so ANY explicitly-labeled chunk here would collide on the
     2nd+ dataset ("Duplicate chunk label"). Every chunk below is therefore
     deliberately ANONYMOUS (no label after the `r`).
  2. Section headers are produced via cat("### ...") INSIDE an eval-gated
     results='asis' chunk (same convention as sc_report_template.Rmd's own
     sections), NOT as static markdown text -- a static "### Deconvolution"
     heading would always render even when eval=FALSE for every chunk
     beneath it, leaving a visibly EMPTY section for any dataset where that
     step was never computed. Gating the heading itself means a section is
     fully absent, not empty, when its data doesn't exist -- exactly "LE
     MAXIMUM D'EXPORT, meme si non affiche, juste calcule" without ever
     showing dead section titles.
-->

```{r, include=FALSE}
res <- ds$results %||% list()
qc_ready      <- "qc" %in% params$sections && !is.null(res$qc_metrics)
cluster_ready <- "cluster" %in% params$sections && !is.null(res$cluster_labels)
deconv_ready  <- "deconv" %in% params$sections && !is.null(res$deconv_props)
moran_ready   <- "moran" %in% params$sections && !is.null(res$moran_results)
niche_ready   <- "niche" %in% params$sections && !is.null(res$niche_labels)
umap_ready    <- "umap" %in% params$sections && !is.null(res$umap_df)
viz_ready     <- "custom_viz" %in% params$sections && length(res$saved_viz_list %||% list()) > 0
any_ready     <- qc_ready || cluster_ready || deconv_ready || moran_ready || niche_ready || umap_ready || viz_ready

# Base spot/cell table (id, x, y) for this dataset -- used by every spatial
# map below. NULL-safe: a dataset with no coords simply skips every map.
.ds_base_df <- if (!is.null(ds$coords) && length(ds$sketch_ids) > 0) {
  ds$coords[match(ds$sketch_ids, ds$coords$id), c("id", "x", "y")]
} else NULL
```

```{r, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", ds_name))
cat(sprintf("%s\n\n",
            tr_fmt(tr("*{tech} -- {n} elements (total) -- {sk} en sketch RAM*"),
                   tech = ds$technology,
                   n = format(ds$n_total, big.mark = ","),
                   sk = format(length(ds$sketch_ids), big.mark = ","))))
```

```{r, eval=!any_ready, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("*%s*\n\n---\n\n", tr("Aucune section calculee pour cet echantillon au moment de l'export.")))
```

```{r, eval=qc_ready, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", tr("QC")))
if (!is.null(res$qc_params)) {
  cat(paste0(tr("Seuils appliques : "),
             sprintf("nCount >= %s, nFeature >= %s, %%MT <= %s", res$qc_params$min_count,
                     res$qc_params$min_features, res$qc_params$max_pct_mt), "\n\n"))
} else {
  cat(paste0(tr("Seuils appliques : "), tr("non enregistres"), "\n\n"))
}
if (!is.null(res$qc_pass_idx)) {
  cat(sprintf("**%d / %d** %s\n\n", length(res$qc_pass_idx), nrow(res$qc_metrics), tr("elements retenus")))
}
```
```{r, eval=qc_ready, fig.height=4}
df_qc <- res$qc_metrics
p1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_qc, ggplot2::aes(x = nCount)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#2C3E50") + ggplot2::theme_minimal() + ggplot2::labs(title="nCount")
p2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_qc, ggplot2::aes(x = nFeature)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#18BC9C") + ggplot2::theme_minimal() + ggplot2::labs(title="nFeature")
p3 <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_qc, ggplot2::aes(x = pct_mt)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#E74C3C") + ggplot2::theme_minimal() + ggplot2::labs(title="% MT")
patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 3)
```
```{r, eval=qc_ready && !is.null(.ds_base_df)}
m <- match(.ds_base_df$id, res$qc_metrics$id)
df_map <- data.frame(x = .ds_base_df$x, y = .ds_base_df$y, value = res$qc_metrics$nCount[m])
render_plot_spatial(df_map, title = "nCount (carte)", histology = ds$histology_overlay)
```

```{r, eval=cluster_ready, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", tr("Clustering (BANKSY-lite)")))
extra <- if (!is.null(res$cluster_params)) sprintf(" (lambda=%s, resolution=%s)",
          res$cluster_params$lambda, res$cluster_params$resolution) else ""
cat(sprintf("%s\n\n", tr_fmt(tr("**{n} clusters** sur {total} elements.{extra}"),
                             n = length(unique(res$cluster_labels)),
                             total = length(res$cluster_labels), extra = extra)))
```

```{r, eval=cluster_ready && !is.null(.ds_base_df)}
render_plot_spatial(df_map, title = tr("Clusters spatiaux"), histology = ds$histology_overlay)
```

```{r, eval=viz_ready, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", tr("Visualisations sauvegardees")))
cat(sprintf("*%s*\n\n", tr("Vues ajoutees depuis l'onglet \"4. Visualisation\" (bouton \"Ajouter cette vue au rapport\") -- reconstruites a partir des DERNIERS resultats disponibles au moment du rendu de ce rapport.")))
# Loop-safe pattern (mirrors sc_report_template.Rmd's own custom_viz_loop):
# an unknown number of iterations inside ONE results='asis' chunk needs
# EXPLICIT handling per item -- print(htmltools::tagList(...)) for an
# interactive widget, or an explicit ggsave() + markdown image link for the
# static fallback -- rather than relying on implicit end-of-chunk auto-print,
# which is only proven safe for a SINGLE plot per chunk (see every other
# section above).
viz_list <- res$saved_viz_list %||% list()
for (nm in names(viz_list)) {
  cfg <- viz_list[[nm]]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n**%s** (%s)\n\n", nm,
              tr_fmt(tr("colore par : {x}"), x = cfg$color_by %||% "?")))
  df_v <- tryCatch(build_saved_viz_df(ds$sketch, ds$coords, cfg, res), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df_v)) {
    cat(sprintf("%s\n\n", tr("*(donnees indisponibles pour reconstruire cette vue -- relancez le calcul correspondant puis re-sauvegardez la vue depuis l'onglet 4)*")))
    next
  }
  interactive_ok <- isTRUE(params$interactive) && knitr::is_html_output() && requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)
  if (interactive_ok) {
    print(render_plot_spatial(df_v, title = nm, histology = ds$histology_overlay))
  } else {
    tmp_png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    p_static <- render_spatial_static_map(df_v, title = nm, histology = ds$histology_overlay)
    ggplot2::ggsave(tmp_png, p_static, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 130, bg = "white")
    cat(sprintf("\n\n![%s](%s)\n\n", nm, tmp_png))
  }
}
```
